framework: review-specific mixed-method risk-of-bias and applicability appraisal

dimensions.name: internal validity
dimensions.rationale: Probe groups were separately sampled with repeated stages and participant random effects, but only 16 participants contributed to each probe group.

dimensions.name: measurement validity
dimensions.rationale: Human-coded Gricean outcomes and participant experience are relevant proxies but not external validity criteria.

dimensions.name: external validity
dimensions.rationale: Desktop-only U.S. Prolific participants completed HCI tasks about technology stress.

applicability: Strong design evidence for selecting probes; limited generalization beyond short online HCI survey tasks.
